calls.video_title: Why I'm Not Buying Duolingo Stock (Yet)
calls.thesis: Reiterated HOLD: fairly valued to slightly undervalued but elevated AI-disruption risk; wait for a better entry (needs 5-10%+ margin of safety, larger for DUOL).
calls.base_case: DCF fair value $149 vs $143; forward PE 19 near all-time low.
calls.bull_case: Management pivoting to customer acquisition; targeting 100M DAUs in next couple years; ROIC 30% (>2x WACC), could rebound if acquisition pays off.
calls.bear_case: AI and big-tech language offerings reducing need to learn languages; freemium push comes at expense of monetization and may compress record 14.2% operating margins.

calls.thesis: First tracked: fair value cut from previous as growth slowed and monetization traded for user growth; earnings tomorrow could move it either way.
calls.bear_case: Earnings tomorrow could cut fair value further
